$comment: Frontend side of the backend contract. The canonical schema is the backend's Pydantic models (owner: Muhammad). Do not hand-write wire types here: fill in `schema` with the official component names once the OpenAPI document exists. `source` and `examplesDir` are the proposed shared locations and are not created by the frontend.

recognizedSign.description: One recognized sign streamed by the model. Feeds the live sign feed (UI type RecognizedSign).

englishDraft.description: English text generated from a run of signs, shown for user confirmation (UI type EnglishDraft).

errorMessage.description: Error reported by the backend or model, surfaced in the UI.

recognitionInput.description: What the desktop sends for recognition (video frame, landmarks, ...). Depends on the backend's design.

draftConfirmation.description: Sent when the user confirms or edits a draft, if the backend wants it.

sessionControl.description: Session start/stop messages, if the backend uses them.
